reuse.reason: Complete marked fork of the pinned official Models settings package. DeepSeek provider UI/editor and configuration semantics stay official; the fork adds only a read-only provider row for the independent operator-managed Cloudflare AI Gateway provider, rendering its official provider-card instead of the unknown-namespace YAML editor. The anonymous Models surface additionally reuses this component through a minimal controller face and an optional public-declarations presentation. Public rows are visible without asserting owner configuration, all editors remain read-only, and the unchanged Add provider button can request authentication through an explicit Host callback. Default live rendering and operations remain unchanged.
gaps: The independent Gateway row is read-only by design; Gateway configuration is operator-managed. DeepSeek remains the official editable provider.
